notes.title: Battle mode
notes.content:
Major update introducing a battle workout using the exercises to defeat the opponent.

This update also adds several new exercise flavors and the ability to take part in online challenges

Here is an example of an active Halloween challenge which you can participate in:
https://portal.vrworkout.at/share/8265e81257c44ea0a0cfa5db97ee958f/


Features added

[list]
[*] CPU enemies you can play against in battle mode
[*] Squat avoid queue
[*] Jump squats in Hard and Ultra mode
[*] Windmill exercise
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Save exercises in slots for replayin them
[*] 4 only challenge slots 
[*] Good streak reward
[*] Updated avatars
[/list]

notes.title: Song and feature update
notes.content:
Thanks to the Rainbow Reactor team (also on Steam), this release adds more songs.

The heart rate targeting mode can now be set to a specific heart rate, previously it was only the default 140BPM

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Better balanced scoring
[*] High intensity side planks with follow up pushup
[*] Improved timing of the burpees
[*] Add overall workout score
[*] Instructor motivation on longer streaks
[*] Improve double swing cues
[*] Better visibility of the point indicator
[*] Option to extend the exercise switch time for floor to stand transitions ( active be default )
[/list]

If you are after the maximum possible intensity you should switch from "Easy transition" to "Regular transition" to disable the extended switching time between exercises.

Please join the VRWorkout discord for information how patrons can access the online features.
[url=https://discord.gg/Vg3vyah]VRWorkout Discord[/url]

notes.title: Workout update
notes.content:
The player can select from exercise presets instead of switching each exercise on individually.

In addition to the random workouts, the game now has 3 different exercise sequences

* Low pyramid
* High pyramid
* VRWorkout challenge

The pyramids are 10,20,30,20,10 exercises. Low is focused on floor exercises high focuses on standing jumping and sprinting exercises

The VRWorkout challenge is a mix of all exercises in a fixes sequence to make workouts comparison easier between different players and is in preparation for a full online mode.

Features for Patrons:
[url=https://www.patreon.com/vrworkout]VRWorkout Patreon[/url] 
The game now has the ability to integrate with the VRHealth Institute app as well as the VRWorkout online portal to analyze and share the workout results.

[list]
[*] The VRHealth integration adds the heart rate into the game through the VRHealth Institute app
[*] The portal connection will make the workout statistics available through the VRWorkout online portal, and for privacy reasons is deactivated by default. Attention: Simply enabling it will not immediately work without registering the device in the portal first. [/list]

Sample workout analysis: [url=https://portal.vrworkout.at/share/bea6b35d10f649af8a113b9ab7d8f6f7/]portal.vrworkout.at[/url]

Please join the VRWorkout discord for information how patrons can access the online features.
[url=https://discord.gg/Vg3vyah]VRWorkout Discord[/url]

notes.title: Custom songs update
notes.content:
This release adds support for customs songs. 
Place OGG files in C:\VRWorkout and they will show up in the song selection menu
Please make sure that the OGG files are Stereo files. 

Strength mode focuses less on cardio and more on pure strength. 

Added an audio visualizer
